hero.label: Fondation Lefoulon-Delalande
hero.title: Supporting cardiovascular medical research
hero.desc: Founded in 2000, the Fondation Lefoulon-Delalande supports scientists who advance cardiovascular medicine through its Scientific Prize and Research Grants.

intro.label: Our vocation
intro.title: Contributing to cardiovascular research
intro.p1: The Fondation Lefoulon-Delalande aims to contribute, through financial support, to medical research in the cardiovascular field in the broadest sense, including: physiology, biology, medicine, epidemiology, pharmacology, cell differentiation, congenital malformations.
intro.p2: Each year, it awards a Scientific Grand Prize to a renowned international scientist and grants to young French post-doctoral researchers working full-time on cardiovascular topics.

grand_prix.title: Scientific Grand Prize
grand_prix.desc: Awarded annually since 2002 to an international scientist who has made a major contribution to cardiovascular physiology, biology or medicine.

grants.title: Research Grants
grants.desc: Awarded annually since 2001 to young post-doctoral researchers working full-time in a French research institution on cardiovascular topics.

about.page_desc: Discover the history and mission of the Fondation Lefoulon-Delalande, founded in 2000 in tribute to Michel Delalande.
about.history_desc: The Fondation Lefoulon-Delalande was created in December 2000 to honour the memory of Mr Michel Delalande, Founder and President of the Delalande pharmaceutical group.
about.xavier_darcos: Xavier Darcos, Chancellor of the Institut de France
about.mission_lead: The Fondation Lefoulon-Delalande aims to contribute, through financial support, to medical research in the cardiovascular field, in the broadest sense, including: physiology, biology, medicine, epidemiology, pharmacology, cell differentiation, congenital malformations and, within these disciplines, advanced biological, pharmaceutical and instrumental therapies.
about.m1_desc: Reward, on a personal basis, a scientist who has made a major contribution to cardiovascular medicine.
about.m2_desc: Award grants to post-doctoral researchers working in the cardiovascular field within a French institution.
about.m3_desc: A foundation placed under the aegis of the Institut de France, a guarantee of rigour, independence and scientific excellence.
about.m4_desc: A scientific council made up of leading French and international figures to guarantee the excellence of the laureates.
about.edito_quote: “The Fondation Lefoulon-Delalande brilliantly embodies the tradition of scientific excellence upheld by the Institut de France. Through its Prizes and Grants, it helps advance cardiovascular medicine for the benefit of all.”
about.edito_cite: Xavier Darcos — Chancellor of the Institut de France
about.history_lead: The Fondation Lefoulon-Delalande was created in December 2000 to honour the memory of Mr Michel Delalande, Founder and President of the Delalande pharmaceutical group.
about.t1_text: Michel Delalande is born in Saint-Just-en-Chaussée, in the Oise. The son of a country doctor, he develops a passion for chemistry and turns to pharmacy studies.
about.t2_text: Michel Delalande marries Hélène Spindler. Through loans, he buys back his uncle’s laboratory and a Parisian pharmacy. Professors Charonnat and Delaby develop “Solucamphre”, marking the start of a remarkable industrial success.
about.t3_text: The war disrupts his plans: he is assigned to a post as a nurse. After the war, he sits the residency examination and specialises in organic and biological chemistry.
about.t4_text: The Delalande group develops a research centre, creates cardiology medicines, manufactures raw materials and expands internationally. Michel Delalande stands out for a forward-thinking approach (proportional salary, profit-sharing). He is promoted Officer of the Legion of Honour in 1972.
about.t5_text: Michel Delalande passes away, having co-founded the Action Sociale Pharmaceutique and left the mark of a humanist entrepreneur.
about.t6_text: The Fondation Lefoulon-Delalande is created under the aegis of the Institut de France to honour his memory and support cardiovascular research.
about.t7_text: First award of the Research Grants to young French post-doctoral researchers in cardiovascular science.
about.t8_text: Creation of the Lefoulon-Delalande Scientific Grand Prize, worth €600,000, one of the largest scientific prizes in France in the medical field.
about.gov_lead: The Fondation Lefoulon-Delalande is placed under the authority of the Institut de France. Its Scientific Council, made up of leading French and international figures, guarantees the excellence and impartiality of decisions.
about.gov_box_title: Under the aegis of the Institut de France
about.gov_box_body: A public-interest foundation placed under the high authority of the Institut de France — an institution bringing together the five French academies (Académie française, Académie des inscriptions et belles-lettres, Académie des sciences, Académie des beaux-arts, Académie des sciences morales et politiques).

grand_prix.page_desc: Created in 2002, the Grand Prize is awarded annually to a scientist who has made a major contribution to cardiovascular medicine.
grand_prix.intro_desc: The Lefoulon-Delalande Grand Prize is worth €600,000. It rewards a scientist who has made a significant contribution to cardiovascular physiology, biology or medicine.
grand_prix.apply_desc: The Grand Prize is open to international nominations. Download the rules and submit your nomination.
grand_prix.desc_p1: Created in 2002, the Grand Prize is awarded each year to a scientist who has made a significant scientific contribution to cardiovascular physiology, biology or medicine. This definition, in its broadest sense, includes genetics, epidemiology, physiology, clinical research, imaging, therapeutics, pharmacology, and the development of the cardiovascular system.
grand_prix.desc_p2: The Grand Prize jury is composed of the members of the Foundation's Scientific Council, leading French and international figures in the cardiovascular field.

grants.page_desc: Created in 2001, the Research Grants support young post-doctoral researchers working in a French research institution.
conditions: Hold a PhD in medicine, science, pharmacy or veterinary science
Work full-time in a French research institution
Conduct research in the cardiovascular field
Research internships abroad are not eligible
grants.intro_p1: Created in 2001 and awarded each year, the research grants of the Fondation Lefoulon-Delalande aim to promote the activities of a post-doctoral researcher working full-time in the cardiovascular field within a French research institution; research internships abroad are not eligible.
grants.intro_p2: The research subject may concern development, physiology, pathologies, epidemiology, or medical or surgical cardiovascular therapies, excluding research on oncology.
grants.c1: Hold a PhD in medicine, science, pharmacy or veterinary science (or an equivalent diploma)
grants.c2: Work full-time in a French research institution
grants.c3: Conduct research in the cardiovascular field (physiology, pathologies, epidemiology, medical or surgical therapies)
grants.c4: Research internships abroad are not eligible
grants.apply_desc: A jury of six to eight French scientific figures is formed to select the grant candidates. Submit your application via the contact form.
grants.lt1: Pathophysiology of experimental dissecting aortic aneurysm in JAK2V617F-positive myeloproliferative syndromes
grants.lt2: Fibrillin-1: a new player in angiogenesis, exploring its therapeutic potential for vascular repair
grants.lt3: Identification of modifying genetic factors in laminopathies affecting striated muscles
grants.lt4: Production of cardiac pseudo-tissues derived from human induced pluripotent stem cells as a preclinical study model of Arrhythmogenic Right Ventricular Cardiomyopathy (ARVC)
grants.lt5: Automatic extraction of sudden-death risk markers combining black-blood MRI of myocardial scars and artificial intelligence
grants.lt6: Cardiac ageing and induced remodelling in atrial fibrillation
grants.lt7: Efferocytosis and control of myocardial remodelling by macrophages
grants.lt8: Custom balloon-expandable stent for paediatric and congenital heart diseases
grants.lt9: Importance of pleasant touch in the mechanisms of cardiac regulation by the vagus nerve
grants.lt10: New stimulation method to prevent the onset of ventricular tachyarrhythmias during chronic myocardial infarction
grants.lt11: Spatio-temporal study of neuro-inflammatory remodelling during heart failure in mice
grants.lt12: High-throughput phenotyping of variants of the KCNH2 gene coding for the hERG cardiac potassium channel

privacy.page_desc: Privacy policy and personal data management.
privacy.body:
1. Data controller

The controller of personal data collected on this website is the Fondation Lefoulon-Delalande, Institut de France, 23 quai de Conti, 75006 Paris, France.

2. Data collected

We only collect the personal data that you voluntarily provide via our contact form:

  • First and last name
  • Email address
  • Phone number (optional)
  • Subject of your request
  • Content of your message
  • Any attachments (for applications)

3. Purposes of processing

The data collected is used exclusively to:

  • Respond to your requests for information
  • Process your applications for the Scientific Grand Prize or Research Grants
  • Inform you of the Foundation’s news (on express request)

4. Legal basis for processing

The processing of your personal data is based on your consent (art. 6.1.a GDPR) and on the necessity of carrying out the pre-contractual steps you have requested (art. 6.1.b GDPR).

5. Retention period

Your personal data is kept for a maximum period of:

  • 3 years for simple information requests
  • 5 years for application files (Grand Prize and Grants)

Beyond these periods, your data is deleted or anonymised.

6. Data recipients

Your personal data is processed only by the teams of the Fondation Lefoulon-Delalande and the members of the Scientific Council (for applications). It is never passed on to commercial third parties.

7. Your rights

In accordance with the GDPR, you have the following rights:

  • Right of access: you can request to view your data
  • Right to rectification: you can request the correction of inaccurate data
  • Right to erasure: you can request the deletion of your data (“right to be forgotten”)
  • Right to portability: you can request to receive your data in a structured format
  • Right to object: you can object to the processing of your data
  • Right to restriction: you can request the restriction of processing

To exercise these rights, contact us via the contact form. You also have the right to lodge a complaint with the CNIL (www.cnil.fr).

8. Cookies

This website uses only technical cookies strictly necessary for its proper operation (remembering the selected language). No tracking or profiling cookies are used.

9. Security

We implement appropriate technical and organisational measures to protect your personal data against any loss, unauthorised access, disclosure or alteration.

10. Contact

For any question relating to this privacy policy or the exercise of your rights, contact us via our contact form.

Last updated: January 2024
